description: Paginator is a pagination / paging library for Kotlin Multiplatform (Android, iOS, JVM, Desktop, JS, Wasm). A pure-Kotlin alternative to Jetpack Paging 3 with cursor-based pagination, bidirectional scroll (chat / messenger feeds), jump-to-page, bookmarks, pluggable page caching (LRU / FIFO / TTL), element-level CRUD, infinite scroll, prefetch, state serialization via kotlinx.serialization, and reactive UI state via Kotlin Flows. Zero platform dependencies — usable across data, domain and presentation layers in Clean Architecture.
